notes: HIGH_RISK can never silently downgrade itself to STANDARD or FAST — a match against any HIGH_RISK criterion is final for that change set. Mythos Automation's existing LEVEL_3 approval boundaries (docs/AUTOMATION_APPROVAL_MATRIX.md) remain authoritative wherever this file and that matrix overlap; this file classifies developer-workflow risk, not automation-execution risk.

FAST.description: Documentation-only or non-runtime metadata changes with no behavioural surface.
criteria: non-runtime example/config files with no secrets (e.g. *.example.json)
projects/meta/*.json governance metadata (ledger, statistics, portfolio registry, current-context, known-baselines, test-impact-map)
FAST.test_strategy: node scripts/project-intelligence.js validate; JSON/Markdown validation. No product test suite required unless the change touches test-impact-map-referenced paths.

STANDARD.description: Isolated runtime module, adapter, or safe developer tooling change with a clear, contained blast radius.
criteria: a single js/shared/*.js module and its direct callers
a new or extended Agent Development Skill under .claude/skills/
non-destructive integration code with no external network calls enabled by default
STANDARD.test_strategy: targeted tests for the affected module plus its direct callers, per projects/meta/test-impact-map.json; full suite only if targeted tests reveal broader regression risk.

HIGH_RISK.description: Any change with an irreversible, cross-tenant, credentialed, or production-facing blast radius.
criteria: database migration or schema execution (not draft authoring)
external irreversible actions (sending real communications, executing real financial transfers)
references: docs/AUTOMATION_APPROVAL_MATRIX.md (LEVEL_3 boundaries remain authoritative for automation-execution risk)
HIGH_RISK.test_strategy: full relevant regression suite plus explicit owner review before any close --apply is even considered; close --apply is refused by the Stage Runner for this lane (HIGH_RISK_POLICY_VIOLATION).
